mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sekai_song_playlist(user_id, name, description, cover_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{coverUrl})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sekai_song_playlist WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, COUNT(ps.song_id) AS song_count FROM sekai_song_playlist p LEFT JOIN sekai_song_playlist_song ps ON p.id = ps.playlist_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.id LIMIT 1

SELECT p.*, COUNT(ps.song_id) AS song_count FROM sekai_song_playlist p LEFT JOIN sekai_song_playlist_song ps ON p.id = ps.playlist_id WHERE p.name = #{name} AND p.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT p.*, COUNT(ps.song_id) AS song_count FROM sekai_song_playlist p LEFT JOIN sekai_song_playlist_song ps ON p.id = ps.playlist_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.update_time DESC, p.id DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sekai_song_playlist_song WHERE playlist_id = #{playlistId} AND song_id = #{songId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sekai_song_playlist_song WHERE playlist_id = #{playlistId} AND song_id = #{songId}
